{
  "up": [
    "Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism",
    "Join molecule_dictionary m ON m.molregno = a.molregno",
    "Join activities a ON a.molregno = m.molregno AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.bao_endpoint = 'BAO_0000190'",
    "Join assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'",
    "Join target_dictionary t ON ass.tid = t.tid AND t.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND t.pref_name = 'Lysine-specific histone demethylase 1A'",
    "Join compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = m.molregno",
    "Join docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id",
    "Join pubmed_or_doi p ON d.pubmed_id = p.pubmed_id OR d.doi = p.doi",
    "Filter t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL6136'",
    "Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism",
    "Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism",
    "Limit 2000"
  ]
}
